title: ATME Signs MOU with Aspire For Her
content:
ATME Signs MOU with Aspire For Her

Aspire For Her is a social enterprise that aims at getting more women into the country’s workforce. They provide the following career resources to members:
  • 1:1 Mentorship Sessions in which mentors are experts from industry with over 20 years of professional experience, members can choose their mentors and get mentored.
  • Learning Resources Access to free and certified online courses from their learning partners- IBM, edX and VMware.
  • Career Previews, Webinars and Workshops Interactive events with leading women and institutions from across the country.
  • Job Opportunities Regular job openings from their Employment partners- FairyGodBoss and Women in Tech.
  ATME College of Engineering is happy to announce its MOU with Aspire For Her. This Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) provides the guidelines for carrying out various programs by Aspire For Her at ATME College of Engineering in regard with various academic seminars, webinars, courses, internships and placements through the IBM Open P-TECH platform. Aspire For Her, having their registered office at Flat No. 12, Vishwa Tara, Plot No. 310, 12th Road, Near Madhu Park, Khar West, Mumbai,400052, through its Managing Founder and CEO, Madhura DasGupta Sinha, and ATME College of Engineering, having their registered office at 13th Kilometre, Mysuru – Kanakapura – Bengaluru Road, Mysuru – 570028, Karnataka, through its Principal, Dr. L. Basavaraj have signed the aforementioned MoU on the 14th of August, 2021.
